preconditions.name: local_view_greedy_clears_floor_at_d3
preconditions.description: LocalViewGreedyPolicy reading the SAME 5x5 resource_field_view forages >= the 1.0 competence floor at D3 -- the positive control that the env is solvable from the local view (same statistic the verdict criterion routes on). Below-floor means the substrate/env is not ready, NOT that the actor-critic failed.

preconditions.name: greedy_oracle_clears_floor_at_d3
preconditions.description: Env is floor-achievable with global info (achievability anchor).

preconditions.name: forage_steps_in_measured_window_supra_count_floor
preconditions.description: COUNT readiness matching the count-gated R-(a) criterion: the forage |adv| mass fractions are computed OVER forage-contact steps, so with too few such steps a 'stays tiny' reading is vacuous (no signal to swamp) rather than a falsification of the weak form. Minimum over all probe cells.
preconditions.control: n forage-contact steps in the LATE measurement window, per probe cell

preconditions.name: demo_state_return_spread_supra_floor
preconditions.description: SPREAD readiness matching the spread-gated R-(b) criterion: the collapse test routes on std(V)/std(G), so a degenerate G distribution over demonstrator-visited states makes the ratio uninterpretable. The demonstrator forages (48.05 @D3), so its state distribution MUST carry a bimodal return spread.
preconditions.control: std(return-to-go) over LocalViewGreedyPolicy-visited states, min over cells
